title: Python Booleans & Comparisons
description: Booleans represent one of two values: 'True' or 'False'. In Python, almost any value is evaluated to 'True' if it has some sort of content. Boolean operators like 'and', 'or', and 'not' allow complex logic chains.
example:
// Logical Chains
print(10 > 9) # True
print(10 == 9) # False

# Truthiness
print(bool("abc")) # True
print(bool(0)) # False
